```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set report options and load the packages used in this analysis.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
required_packages <- c("DESeq2","readxl","dplyr","ggplot2","pheatmap","tibble","readr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly=TRUE)]
if(length(missing_packages)) stop("Missing packages: ",paste(missing_packages,collapse=", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(DESeq2);library(readxl);library(dplyr);library(ggplot2);library(pheatmap);library(tibble);library(readr)})
if(!requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly=TRUE)) stop("Package apeglm is required for lfcShrink(type='apeglm'). Install it before knitting.")
safe_write_csv <- function(x,file,row.names=FALSE) utils::write.csv(x,file,row.names=row.names)
```

## Define file paths

```{r file_paths}
# Build paths to the six raw count workbooks.
files <- file.path(params$count_dir,paste0(c("Dere","Dmel","Dsuz","Dsim","Dsec","Dsan"),"_counts.xlsx")); names(files) <- c("Dere","Dmel","Dsuz","Dsim","Dsec","Dsan")
missing <- files[!file.exists(files)]; if(length(missing)) stop("Missing raw count workbook(s): ",paste(normalizePath(missing,winslash="/",mustWork=FALSE),collapse=", "),". Set count_dir to their folder.")
```

## Import and merge counts

```{r import_function}
# Read one workbook, remove blank genes, keep a valid duplicate, and drop remaining missing values.
read_species_counts <- function(file){
 df <- read_excel(file,sheet=1,na=c("","NA")); if(!"DmelID" %in% names(df)) stop("Count file lacks DmelID: ",file)
 cc <- setdiff(names(df),c("DmelID",grep("_gene_name$",names(df),value=TRUE))); if(length(cc)!=3L) stop("Expected three replicate columns in ",file)
 df[cc] <- lapply(df[cc],function(x)suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
 nonempty <- !is.na(df$DmelID)&trimws(as.character(df$DmelID))!=""; has_data <- apply(df[cc],1,function(x)any(!is.na(x)&x!=0)); df <- df[nonempty&has_data,c("DmelID",cc),drop=FALSE]
 df <- df[!duplicated(df$DmelID),,drop=FALSE]; df[complete.cases(df[,cc,drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
}
```

```{r import_data}
# Read every species table and map each sample column to its species.
count_list <- lapply(files,read_species_counts); column_to_species <- list()
for(i in seq_along(count_list)) for(col in setdiff(names(count_list[[i]]),"DmelID")) column_to_species[[col]] <- names(files)[i]
merged_counts <- Reduce(function(x,y)full_join(x,y,by="DmelID"),count_list); merged_counts <- merged_counts[complete.cases(merged_counts),,drop=FALSE]
count_matrix <- as.data.frame(merged_counts); rownames(count_matrix) <- count_matrix$DmelID; count_matrix$DmelID <- NULL; count_matrix[] <- lapply(count_matrix,function(x)as.integer(round(x)))
```

```{r metadata}
# Create sample metadata and use Dsim as the reference species.
sample_info <- data.frame(sample=colnames(count_matrix),species=sapply(colnames(count_matrix),function(x)column_to_species[[x]]),row.names=colnames(count_matrix)); sample_info$species <- relevel(factor(sample_info$species),ref="Dsim"); stopifnot(identical(rownames(sample_info),colnames(count_matrix)))
```

## Run DESeq2

```{r deseq2}
# Build the model, apply the group-aware count filter, and fit DESeq2.
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_matrix,colData=sample_info,design=~species); smallestGroupSize <- min(table(sample_info$species)); dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)>=10)>=smallestGroupSize,]; dds <- DESeq(dds)
safe_write_csv(as.data.frame(counts(dds,normalized=TRUE)),"normalized_counts_all_species2.csv",row.names=TRUE); vsd_mat <- assay(vst(dds,blind=FALSE)); qc_vsd <- vst(estimateSizeFactors(dds),blind=TRUE)
```

```{r pca}
# Plot variance-stabilised samples coloured by species.
print(plotPCA(qc_vsd,intgroup="species"))
```

## Pairwise comparisons

```{r pairwise_results}
# Test every other species against Dsim using threshold-aware p-values and shrunken effects.
comparison_species <- setdiff(levels(sample_info$species),"Dsim"); padj_cutoff <- 0.10; strict_padj_cutoff <- 0.05; lfc_cutoff <- 0.5; strict_lfc_cutoff <- 1
results_list <- list(); tested_genes_by_contrast <- list(); summary_table <- list()
for(sp in comparison_species){
 coef_name <- grep(paste0("^species_",sp,"_vs_Dsim$"),resultsNames(dds),value=TRUE)
 if(length(coef_name) != 1L) stop("Expected exactly one coefficient matching ",sp," vs the reference level; found ",length(coef_name),". apeglm requires `coef`, so the focal species must be the reference level (check the relevel() call).")
 raw_mle <- results(dds,name=coef_name,alpha=padj_cutoff)
 raw <- results(dds,name=coef_name,alpha=padj_cutoff,lfcThreshold=lfc_cutoff,altHypothesis="greaterAbs")
 strict <- results(dds,name=coef_name,alpha=strict_padj_cutoff,lfcThreshold=strict_lfc_cutoff,altHypothesis="greaterAbs")
 shr <- lfcShrink(dds,coef=coef_name,res=raw_mle,type="apeglm")
 df <- as.data.frame(raw) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>% rename(threshold_log2FoldChange=log2FoldChange, threshold_pvalue=pvalue)
 df$raw_log2FoldChange <- as.data.frame(raw_mle)$log2FoldChange; df$raw_pvalue <- as.data.frame(raw_mle)$pvalue; df$raw_padj <- as.data.frame(raw_mle)$padj
 df$log2FoldChange <- as.data.frame(shr)$log2FoldChange; df$strict_padj <- as.data.frame(strict)$padj
 df <- df %>% mutate(significant=!is.na(padj)&padj<padj_cutoff, significant_strict=!is.na(strict_padj)&strict_padj<strict_padj_cutoff, higher_in_Dsim=significant&log2FoldChange<0, lower_in_Dsim=significant&log2FoldChange>0)
 results_list[[sp]] <- df; tested_genes_by_contrast[[sp]] <- df$gene[!is.na(df$threshold_pvalue)]; safe_write_csv(df,paste0("DESeq2_",sp,"_vs_Dsim.csv"))
 summary_table[[sp]] <- data.frame(comparison=paste0(sp,"_vs_Dsim"),genes_tested=sum(!is.na(df$threshold_pvalue)),significant_genes=sum(df$significant,na.rm=TRUE),significant_genes_strict=sum(df$significant_strict,na.rm=TRUE),higher_in_Dsim=sum(df$higher_in_Dsim,na.rm=TRUE),lower_in_Dsim=sum(df$lower_in_Dsim,na.rm=TRUE))
}
contrast_summary <- bind_rows(summary_table); stopifnot(all(contrast_summary$significant_genes == contrast_summary$higher_in_Dsim + contrast_summary$lower_in_Dsim)); zero_shrunken_by_contrast <- bind_rows(lapply(names(results_list), function(sp) data.frame(comparison=paste0(sp,"_vs_Dsim"),significant_shrunken_log2FC_exactly_zero=sum(results_list[[sp]]$significant & results_list[[sp]]$log2FoldChange == 0,na.rm=TRUE)))); zero_shrunken_by_contrast; safe_write_csv(contrast_summary,"DESeq2_contrast_summary_and_sensitivity.csv"); contrast_summary
```

```{r volcano_plots}
# Full scientific names used in plot labels.
species_names <- c(
  Dere = "D. erecta",
  Dmel = "D. melanogaster",
  Dsim = "D. simulans",
  Dsec = "D. sechellia",
  Dsan = "D. santomea",
  Dsuz = "D. suzukii"
)

# Set these three values according to the script's reference species.
reference_code <- "Dsim"
reference_label <- species_names[[reference_code]]
higher_reference_column <- "higher_in_Dsim"
lower_reference_column <- "lower_in_Dsim"

plot_volcano <- function(x, sp) {

  comparison_label <- species_names[[sp]]

  d <- x %>%
    mutate(
      y = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
      status = case_when(
        .data[[higher_reference_column]] ~
          paste("Higher in", reference_label),
        .data[[lower_reference_column]] ~
          paste("Higher in", comparison_label),
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )

  plot_title <- bquote(
    italic(.(reference_label)) ~ "vs" ~ italic(.(comparison_label))
  )

  ggplot(d, aes(log2FoldChange, y, colour = status)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.80, size = 2.5) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "red4"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Shrunken log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
}

for (sp in comparison_species) {
  print(plot_volcano(results_list[[sp]], sp))
}
```

```{r heatmaps}
# Draw a heatmap from the top 75 significant genes in each contrast.
for(sp in comparison_species){ top <- results_list[[sp]] %>% filter(significant) %>% arrange(padj,desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>% slice_head(n=75) %>% pull(gene); if(length(top)<2) next; ks <- rownames(sample_info)[sample_info$species %in% c("Dsim",sp)]; hm <- vsd_mat[top,ks,drop=FALSE]; hm <- hm[apply(hm,1,sd)>0,,drop=FALSE]; if(nrow(hm)<2) next; pheatmap(t(scale(t(hm))),annotation_col=sample_info[ks,"species",drop=FALSE],fontsize_row=6,main=paste("Top 75 genes:",sp,"vs Dsim")) }
```
